title: Marketplace Refresh — Review & Launch Readiness Checklist (AWS + GCP)
content:
Last updated: 2025-02-07 (owner: Talia)

Purpose
- Single checklist to pass AWS Marketplace + GCP Marketplace review and be ready for GA launch.
- Intended to be used in weekly XFN sync + in the final “submit/go-live” meeting.

How to use
- Mark each line item as: NOT STARTED | IN PROGRESS | BLOCKED | DONE
- Add links in Notes column (drafts, PRs, partner portal tickets, evidence index, etc.)
- For security statements: verify against Security FAQ + Security Packet before marking DONE.


CHECKLIST TABLE (copy/paste friendly)
Columns: Area | Item | Owner | Target date | Status | Notes / links

A) SKU + Packaging (Internal consistency)
- SKU + Packaging | Final SKU names & descriptions consistent across AWS, GCP, Redwood Console, internal billing | Nikhil Sharma / Lauren Bishop / Vivek Kulkarni | 2025-01-24 | IN PROGRESS | Use packaging v2 as source of truth; flag any platform-specific naming constraints
- SKU + Packaging | SKU → internal plan code mapping finalized (Hosted/Dedicated/Private + add-ons) | Cole Summers / Nadia Rahman | 2025-01-27 | IN PROGRESS | Reference mapping sheet; confirm all meters exist + invoice descriptions make sense
- SKU + Packaging | Upgrade/downgrade policy for marketplace buyers finalized + approved (and reflected in FAQ) | Naomi Feldman / Michael Grant / Laura Bennett | 2025-01-31 | IN PROGRESS | Align with PM-876; avoid promising “instant downgrade” if not supported
- SKU + Packaging | Confirm add-ons: Compliance/Retention/Premium SLA availability by deployment mode + by marketplace | Naomi Feldman / Soojin Lee | 2025-01-31 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure we don’t imply compliance add-ons apply to Hosted if only Dedicated/Private supported

B) Listing Copy (AWS)
- AWS Listing | Headline + short description meet AWS field limits; no prohibited claims | Soojin Lee | 2025-01-23 | DONE | Final copy in aws-marketplace-listing-copy-draft
- AWS Listing | Long description includes: what it is, key benefits, deployment options, supported regions (accurate) | Soojin Lee / Mina Haddad | 2025-01-24 | IN PROGRESS | Double-check region language vs actual routing + availability
- AWS Listing | Feature bullets: performance/latency phrasing is defensible (no absolute guarantees) | Soojin Lee / Marcus Lin | 2025-01-24 | IN PROGRESS | Avoid “zero data retention” unless explicitly configurable & true for SKU
- AWS Listing | Pricing section references SKU structure (no off-platform pricing promises) | Laura Bennett / Rishi Malhotra | 2025-01-27 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure consistent naming; don’t mention discount % in listing
- AWS Listing | Keywords/categories finalized (avoid competitor trademarks) | Camila Reyes | 2025-01-27 | IN PROGRESS | Check AWS restricted words list
- AWS Listing | Support contact + SLA language consistent with actual support tiers | Dev Patel / Jordan Blake | 2025-01-28 | IN PROGRESS | Must match support docs + contract language

C) Listing Copy (GCP)
- GCP Listing | Solution description formatted per GCP template; includes “How to deploy” steps | Soojin Lee / Elliot Price | 2025-01-25 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure steps align with actual onboarding wizard + docs
- GCP Listing | Marketplace FAQs include: billing, procurement, upgrades/downgrades, support | Markus Klein / Dev Patel | 2025-01-29 | IN PROGRESS | Keep answers consistent with customer FAQ draft + legal constraints
- GCP Listing | Technical validation requirements satisfied (deployment artifacts, permissions, etc.) | Ethan Park / Cole Summers | 2025-02-03 | IN PROGRESS | Track validation feedback in partner-feedback-log

D) Security Claims + Documentation (must be consistent everywhere)
- Security | Security FAQ (AWS/GCP) updated and approved by SecEng + GRC | Dr. Aisha Rahman / Marcus Lin / Olga Petrov | 2025-01-30 | IN PROGRESS | Use approved phrasing: encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, audit logging scope
- Security | Security packet draft finalized; “shareable vs NDA-only” evidence clearly marked | Olga Petrov | 2025-01-30 | IN PROGRESS | Confirm SOC 2 report handling instructions; provide pen test attestation letter if available
- Security | Shared responsibility model included (what Redwood controls vs customer config) | Marcus Lin | 2025-01-31 | IN PROGRESS | Must be included in FAQ or attachments
- Security | Data retention + deletion language verified vs product behavior per SKU | Naomi Feldman / Marcus Lin | 2025-01-31 | IN PROGRESS | Avoid blanket “no training on customer data” unless formally in policy + true for all modes
- Security | Data residency/region language verified (esp. EU wording) | Mina Haddad / Lukas Meyer (via email thread) | 2025-02-03 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure we don’t promise “EU-only processing” unless enforced by routing + contract
- Security | Audit logging claim verified (what events, retention, export) | Marcus Lin / Allison Grant | 2025-02-03 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure parity between Console screenshots and claims

E) Screenshots + Diagrams (marketplace-required assets)
- Assets | Screenshot inventory complete; owners assigned; redaction requirements identified | Camila Reyes / DES-212 owner | 2025-01-24 | IN PROGRESS | Reference marketplace-screenshot-inventory
- Assets | Console onboarding wizard screenshots updated to latest UI (org linking + entitlement status) | Chloe Martin / Design | 2025-01-29 | IN PROGRESS | Must reflect final strings from DES-213
- Assets | Usage analytics/cost dashboard screenshot (token/cost breakdown) approved (no real customer data) | Allison Grant | 2025-01-29 | IN PROGRESS | Use demo org; confirm graphs don’t include sensitive IDs
- Assets | Architecture/security diagram included (high-level, accurate) | Marcus Lin / Ethan Park | 2025-01-31 | IN PROGRESS | Avoid network-level details that create risk; keep diagram consistent with security packet
- Assets | Accessibility pass on screenshots (legibility, alt-text if required by portal) | Elliot Price | 2025-02-03 | NOT STARTED | Depends on final image exports

F) Links + Docs Site (customer-facing readiness)
- Docs | AWS Marketplace onboarding doc published + linked from listing | Elliot Price / Kira Thompson | 2025-02-03 | IN PROGRESS | github:redwood-docs/pr-4821
- Docs | GCP Marketplace onboarding doc published + linked from listing | Elliot Price / Kira Thompson | 2025-02-03 | IN PROGRESS | github:redwood-docs/pr-4829
- Docs | “Buying via marketplace” FAQ published; includes procurement + billing info | Markus Klein / Dev Patel | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure refund/credit wording is accurate per marketplace policy
- Docs | Redirects + nav updates in docs site completed (pricing/getting started → marketplace paths) | Elliot Price | 2025-02-05 | NOT STARTED | Coordinate with docs thread; verify no broken links
- Docs | UTM tracking plan for marketplace links documented (for attribution) | Ben Carter | 2025-02-05 | IN PROGRESS | Align with HubSpot lifecycle stages; confirm link format in listings

G) Purchase → Provisioning (Technical readiness)
- Provisioning | Entitlement ingestion: AWS path in prod behind feature flag; idempotency verified | Ethan Park | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | github:redwood/pr-18441; confirm retries/backoff
- Provisioning | Entitlement ingestion: GCP path in prod behind feature flag; validation differences documented | Ethan Park | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | github:redwood/pr-18458
- Provisioning | SKU ID mapping table loaded in prod (AWS/GCP SKU IDs → internal entitlements) | Cole Summers | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | Cross-check against ADR + mapping sheet
- Provisioning | Console org linking flow GA-ready (clear steps, error states, self-serve troubleshooting) | Chloe Martin | 2025-02-05 | IN PROGRESS | github:redwood/pr-18477
- Provisioning | Edge cases tested: multiple cloud accounts, wrong org, region mismatch, delayed entitlements | Leila Farouk | 2025-02-06 | IN PROGRESS | Must include both AWS + GCP fixtures; link E2E test runs
- Provisioning | Backfill/repair procedure documented for stuck entitlements (runbook + scripts) | Ethan Park / Rafael Mendes | 2025-02-06 | NOT STARTED | Based on staging incident learnings; ensure minimal manual steps

H) Monitoring + SRE (launch guardrails)
- Monitoring | Dashboards created: entitlement lag, webhook failures, provisioning error rate | Rafael Mendes / Allison Grant | 2025-02-05 | IN PROGRESS | github:redwood/pr-18490; confirm naming + on-call ownership
- Monitoring | Alerts defined with thresholds + paging policy for launch week | Rafael Mendes | 2025-02-06 | IN PROGRESS | Set temporary tighter thresholds for first 2 weeks
- Monitoring | Audit logs for provisioning events verified (what gets logged; retention; access) | Marcus Lin / Rafael Mendes | 2025-02-06 | IN PROGRESS | Ensure logs don’t contain secrets; confirm access controls
- Monitoring | Launch-day “war room” plan: channel, schedule, escalation tree | Connor O'Brien / Talia Benson | 2025-02-07 | NOT STARTED | Identify primary + secondary responders

I) Support + CS Readiness
- Support | Ticket macros/templates created for: entitlement delay, wrong org, region mismatch, invoice confusion | Dev Patel | 2025-02-05 | IN PROGRESS | Reference troubleshooting guide; include “what info to collect” block
- Support | Escalation path documented (Support → Eng on-call → Partnerships if partner-side issue) | Dev Patel / Rafael Mendes | 2025-02-06 | IN PROGRESS | Include partner portal case creation steps
- Support | CS/SE internal one-pager: “How to guide marketplace buyers” published | Markus Klein / Jasmine Liu | 2025-02-06 | IN PROGRESS | Align with enablement slides
- Support | Known limitations list approved (what we can’t do via marketplace) | Jordan Blake / Michael Grant | 2025-02-06 | NOT STARTED | Examples: custom invoice splits, certain discount constructs, retroactive credits

J) Finance + Legal
- Finance/Legal | Marketplace fee + revrec impact reviewed; floor pricing guardrails documented | Laura Bennett / Rishi Malhotra | 2025-01-31 | IN PROGRESS | Confirm how we message “committed spend” and “credits”
- Finance/Legal | Invoice descriptor text verified for all SKUs (buyer-friendly, matches listing) | Cole Summers / Laura Bennett | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | Avoid internal plan codes showing on invoices
- Finance/Legal | Terms alignment: marketplace terms vs direct contract talk track approved | Michael Grant / Jordan Blake | 2025-02-05 | IN PROGRESS | Provide guidance on when to route to direct contract

K) Partner Submission (AWS)
- AWS Submission | Vendor portal access verified; correct roles/MFA; audit trail documented | Partnerships owner (TBD) / Talia Benson | 2025-02-03 | IN PROGRESS | Follow vendor-management process doc
- AWS Submission | All required listing fields completed in portal (incl. support contacts, categories, pricing pages) | Soojin Lee | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | Screenshot portal state before submitting
- AWS Submission | Attachments uploaded: security packet, diagrams, any required policies | Olga Petrov / Marcus Lin | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | Verify shareability; remove NDA-only items from portal
- AWS Submission | Test purchase in AWS staging account completed end-to-end (purchase → entitlement → org link → first call) | Leila Farouk | 2025-02-06 | NOT STARTED | Must capture timestamps for entitlement lag metrics
- AWS Submission | Partner feedback log kept current; all reviewer comments resolved | Talia Benson | Ongoing | IN PROGRESS | Track decisions + diffs

L) Partner Submission (GCP)
- GCP Submission | GCP listing passes automated validation; any required policy links included | Elliot Price / Ethan Park | 2025-02-04 | IN PROGRESS | Keep resubmission notes + validation errors
- GCP Submission | Deployment instructions validated by non-Redwood account (cold start test) | Leila Farouk | 2025-02-06 | NOT STARTED | Ensure docs cover required permissions + where to find entitlement state
- GCP Submission | Partner feedback log kept current; all reviewer comments resolved | Talia Benson | Ongoing | IN PROGRESS | Avoid last-minute structural SKU changes

M) Final Launch Criteria (Go/No-Go)
- Go/No-Go | All “Security Claims + Documentation” items marked DONE; sign-off captured | Dr. Aisha Rahman | 2025-02-07 | IN PROGRESS | Written sign-off in email/thread required
- Go/No-Go | Support readiness confirmed (macros live, escalation tested, owners on calendar) | Dev Patel / Jasmine Liu | 2025-02-07 | IN PROGRESS | Run a 15-min tabletop exercise
- Go/No-Go | Monitoring dashboards + alerts live in prod; on-call aware | Rafael Mendes | 2025-02-07 | IN PROGRESS | Confirm alert routing to correct rotation
- Go/No-Go | Listings have final URLs; docs links verified; no broken links | Elliot Price / Soojin Lee | 2025-02-07 | NOT STARTED | Do a final link-check after publication
- Go/No-Go | Exec launch approval (timing, messaging, risk acceptance) | Camila Reyes / Evelyn Hart | 2025-02-07 | NOT STARTED | Capture in launch brief

Notes / Open Questions (keep short)
- Q: Do we need separate GCP SKUs for Dedicated vs Private or can we bundle? Pending reviewer guidance.
- Q: What’s the exact customer-facing SLA language allowed in marketplace listing vs as a sales attachment?
- Q: How do we message “premium support” for marketplace buyers without implying 24/7 coverage for all tiers?

Changelog
- 2025-02-07: Added explicit Go/No-Go sign-offs, added audit logging verification line item, added cold-start test requirement for GCP.
- 2025-01-28: Expanded Support macros list; added invoice descriptor verification.
- 2025-01-14: Initial draft checklist created from kickoff notes + PRD.
